snippet.title: Pro Pinball - The Web - 5.9B
snippet.description:
A game of The Web, showing off most available game modes and earning a somewhat high score. (Did not get: Ultra and Cow Jackpots, Secret Mania, Final Showdown - still gonna try to get these on video!) The graphics are a bit glitchy - 18 year old games do that, I guess.

I've played this game since I was a kid, and I still like it, but it's definitely the odd duck of the Pro Pinball games. The difference in quality between this and Timeshock! shows through pretty clearly. I'm hoping that Silverball Studios gets around to making an 'Ultra edition' of this game, now that they've started with Timeshock!

Check out the Pro Pinball forums: https://www.pro-pinball.com/forum/

(Might have to reupload if the audio is buggered)
